title: card.wifi Response Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Response containing WiFi connection status and configuration information from the Notecard.

secure.description: `true` means that the WiFi access point is using Management Frame Protection.

security.description: The security protocol the WiFi access point uses. Notecard supports personal (pre-shared key) security only. Will be one of:

sub-descriptions.description: The access point uses no security and requires no password.
The access point uses mixed-mode WPA/WPA2 Personal (PSK).
The access point uses WPA2 Personal (PSK).

ssid.description: The SSID of the WiFi access point.

version.description: The Silicon Labs WF200 WiFi Transceiver binary version.

samples.description: Example response with basic WiFi access point information.
